dominican-republic/zona-colonial.name: Zona Colonial, Santo Domingo
dominican-republic/zona-colonial.description: The oldest European settlement in the Americas, a UNESCO site of plazas, churches and fortresses.
dominican-republic/zona-colonial.details: The Zona Colonial has the first cathedral, the first street (Calle Las Damas) and the Alcazar de Colon, the palace of Diego Columbus. The area is compact and walkable. Evenings are lively with live music and restaurants. Go in the morning, because it is hot and humid by afternoon.

dominican-republic/los-tres-ojos.name: Los Tres Ojos caves
dominican-republic/los-tres-ojos.description: A series of limestone caves with turquoise lagoons on the edge of Santo Domingo.
dominican-republic/los-tres-ojos.details: Los Tres Ojos is a park of sinkholes and lakes, reached by stairs and a small raft. It is a short stop of an hour, close to the airport road. The steps can be slippery when wet.

dominican-republic/jarabacoa-adventures.name: Jarabacoa waterfalls and rafting
dominican-republic/jarabacoa-adventures.description: A mountain town of cool air, waterfalls, river rafting and horse riding.
dominican-republic/jarabacoa-adventures.details: Jarabacoa sits at about 500 metres in the central mountains and is known for the Jimenoa waterfalls, white-water rafting on the Yaque del Norte and coffee. The temperature is far cooler than on the coast. Day trips can include a canyoning option.

dominican-republic/27-charcos.name: 27 Charcos de Damajagua
dominican-republic/27-charcos.description: Waterfall jumping and sliding in a gorge near Puerto Plata.
dominican-republic/27-charcos.details: The 27 Charcos is a river canyon with natural pools. Guided groups hike up and slide or jump back down. Helmets and life jackets are provided. Physical effort and a head for heights are needed. The route runs in groups of varying difficulty.

dominican-republic/puerto-plata-cable-ca.name: Puerto Plata cable car and Amber Museum
dominican-republic/puerto-plata-cable-ca.description: A cable car above the port to a statue of Christ, and a museum of Dominican amber.
dominican-republic/puerto-plata-cable-ca.details: The cable car climbs Mount Isabel de Torres for a view of the coast and a botanical garden. The Amber World Museum in the old town shows Dominican amber with insects trapped inside. The area is a gateway to the north coast.

dominican-republic/cabarete.name: Cabarete kitesurfing and beach
dominican-republic/cabarete.description: A beach town known as a world kitesurfing capital, with waves and a laid-back scene.
dominican-republic/cabarete.details: Cabarete has steady winds all year, especially in the afternoon. Schools offer lessons for kitesurfing, windsurfing and surfing. The beach has beach bars, and the nearby Playa Encuentro has surf.

dominican-republic/samana-whales.name: Samana whale watching or Los Haitises
dominican-republic/samana-whales.description: Humpback whales in Samana Bay from January to March, and mangrove national park trips the rest of the year.
dominican-republic/samana-whales.details: From mid-January to mid-March thousands of humpback whales gather in Samana Bay to breed, and boat tours give close views. At other times, boats tour Los Haitises, a national park of mangroves, caves and limestone islets. Choose an operator that follows whale-watching rules.

dominican-republic/el-limon-waterfall.name: El Limon waterfall
dominican-republic/el-limon-waterfall.description: A 50-metre waterfall reached by horseback ride or hike through the Samana hills.
dominican-republic/el-limon-waterfall.details: The ride to El Limon takes about 30 minutes on horseback from the trailhead, then a short walk down to the falls, with a swimming pool at the base. It is slippery, and a guide is required. Go early.

dominican-republic/las-terrenas-beach.name: Las Terrenas and Playa Bonita
dominican-republic/las-terrenas-beach.description: A relaxed beach town on the Samana Peninsula, with French-influenced cafes and palm-lined sand.
dominican-republic/las-terrenas-beach.details: Las Terrenas has long beaches, seafood restaurants and boutique hotels. Playa Bonita and Playa Cosón are quieter beaches nearby. The pace is slow, and it is a place to unwind between activities.

dominican-republic/saona-island.name: Saona Island
dominican-republic/saona-island.description: A protected island of white sand and natural pools off the south-east coast, a day trip from Punta Cana.
dominican-republic/saona-island.details: Saona Island is part of a national park, reached by speedboat or catamaran. The day includes a stop at a natural pool with starfish and a beach lunch. Weekends are crowded, and some tours are party-focused, so ask what is included.

dominican-republic/punta-cana-beaches.name: Punta Cana beaches
dominican-republic/punta-cana-beaches.description: A long coast of white-sand beaches, with sea and resort life.
dominican-republic/punta-cana-beaches.details: Punta Cana is the main resort area with Bavaro Beach, which has calm water and palm trees. Beaches are public, though many resorts occupy the sand. It is best for a few days of relaxation at the end of a trip.

dominican-republic/altos-de-chavon.name: Altos de Chavon
dominican-republic/altos-de-chavon.description: A recreated sixteenth-century Mediterranean artists village above the Chavon River.
dominican-republic/altos-de-chavon.details: Altos de Chavon sits on a clifftop near La Romana with cobbled streets, an amphitheatre and galleries. It is a pleasant half-day trip from Punta Cana, often combined with Catalina Island or a visit to a cigar factory.

dominican-republic.name: Dominican Republic
dominican-republic.description: A Caribbean country of colonial streets, mountain towns, whale bays and beaches.

dominican-republic/santo-domingo.name: Santo Domingo
dominican-republic/santo-domingo.description: The capital with the oldest colonial city in the Americas.

dominican-republic/jarabacoa.name: Jarabacoa
dominican-republic/jarabacoa.description: A cool mountain town for waterfalls and rafting.

dominican-republic/cabarete.name: Cabarete
dominican-republic/cabarete.description: A north-coast beach town for kitesurfing and water sports.

dominican-republic/samana.name: Samana
dominican-republic/samana.description: A peninsula of palm beaches and whale-watching in winter.

dominican-republic/punta-cana.name: Punta Cana
dominican-republic/punta-cana.description: The east-coast resort area of white-sand beaches.
